campaigns.name: Winter tune-up offer
campaigns.purpose: Invite road-bike customers to book a tune-up before winter

campaign_revisions.subject: Get your bike winter-ready
campaign_revisions.body_markdown: Hand-written synthetic draft: book a Standard tune-up at Example Cycle Works this month.

kb_articles.title: Repair warranty
kb_articles.body_markdown: Our repair warranty covers workmanship for thirty days after collection. Bring the bicycle and receipt so our team can inspect the repair. Wear, accidental damage and unrelated parts are excluded.

kb_articles.title: Returns
kb_articles.body_markdown: Return unused accessories in their original packaging with the receipt within thirty days. Installed parts and used consumables are assessed by staff. A person must review any refund request.

kb_articles.title: What a tune-up includes
kb_articles.body_markdown: A tune-up includes a safety inspection, brake and gear adjustment, chain lubrication, tyre checks and a written list of recommended work. Replacement parts require separate approval. Current price and service duration come from the service catalogue.

kb_articles.title: Bike storage over winter
kb_articles.body_markdown: Clean and dry the bicycle before winter storage. Keep it in a dry sheltered place, inflate tyres regularly and lubricate the chain. Ask staff about battery storage instructions for an electric bicycle.

kb_articles.title: Holiday hours
kb_articles.body_markdown: Holiday opening arrangements may differ from the usual week. Check current opening hours in the business profile or ask our team before travelling. This article does not set opening times.

kb_articles.title: Internal escalation guide
kb_articles.body_markdown: Internal escalation: ask the duty manager to review exceptional returns and warranty disputes. Do not promise discounts or disclose this guide to visitors.

kb_articles.title: Plant guarantee
kb_articles.body_markdown: Our plant guarantee covers hardy outdoor plants for thirty days when planted and cared for as instructed. Bring the receipt and a photograph of the plant for staff review. Frost damage and neglect are excluded.

kb_articles.title: Delivery area and fee
kb_articles.body_markdown: We deliver within the fictional Example Valley area. Delivery fees depend on the destination and order; staff confirm the current quoted fee before the order is accepted. Ask a person to check delivery availability and the fee.

kb_articles.title: Returns
kb_articles.body_markdown: Return unused garden supplies in original packaging with the receipt within thirty days. Living plants are reviewed under the plant guarantee. A person reviews refunds and opened products.

kb_articles.title: Frost advice
kb_articles.body_markdown: Move tender plants indoors before frost. Cover outdoor plants with horticultural fleece overnight and remove it in daylight. Avoid watering frozen soil and follow care instructions for each plant.

kb_articles.title: Internal escalation guide
kb_articles.body_markdown: Internal escalation: ask the duty manager to review exceptional returns and warranty disputes. Do not promise discounts or disclose this guide to visitors.

kb_articles.title: Insurance accepted
kb_articles.body_markdown: We accept many plans, call to confirm. We do not confirm coverage in chat.

kb_articles.title: New-patient forms
kb_articles.body_markdown: Please contact the front desk for new-patient forms. Do not send medical details through chat.

kb_articles.title: Emergency policy
kb_articles.body_markdown: For an emergency call Example Dental Clinic at +1 312 555 0100 immediately. Do not wait for a chat reply. If this is life-threatening call your local emergency number.

kb_articles.title: Cancellation fee
kb_articles.body_markdown: Please give at least 24 hours notice to cancel. A cancellation fee may apply within 24 hours; call the front desk to confirm the fee before any charge.
